identity.name: Casio Standard MTP 1314
identity.one_liner: The 2010 MTP-1314D — the $50 stainless-steel quartz dress watch that defined "a watch that is just a watch" for a generation of first-time buyers.

narrative.story: The MTP-1314D was introduced in 2010 as the entry stainless-steel dress watch in the Casio Standard line. The 1330 quartz module is the standard Casio three-hand quartz with a day-date display. The 39mm stainless steel case, the 50m water resistance, and the mineral crystal are the 2010 specification. The MTP-1314D is the most-cited $50 dress watch and the watch a collector buys as their first watch before they know anything about watches.
narrative.collector_notes: The 1330 quartz module is the same one in the MTP-V002D and the MTP-VD01. The 50m water resistance is the standard Casio dress watch spec.
